name: ki-msh-app
description: KI MSH som app for iOS og Android (Capacitor-skall rundt Home Assistant)

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.serve: npm run build && npx --yes http-server www -p 5173 -c-1
